lines.trans: We are going to release Kuroki's film.
What are you going to do about a sales channel?
I will negotiate with a chain that is adding stores and growing fast right now.
Will something that strange actually sell?
I don't know. Still, I think it is worth staking our shot on.
I am not feeling it. I can't stake Muranishi's life on that girl.
Then how else do you plan to gather the money?
Team up with Furuya and distribute our films underground.
Don't talk nonsense, if we get raided it is all over.

Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).
Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').
